text.en:
The following rates of monthly base pay is hereby authorized and prescribed for commissioned
officers of the Bureau of Coast and Geodetic Survey in each grade as indicated effective January 1, 1976;
Provided, That the rates of pay hereunder prescribed shall not be the basis of (a) retirement gratuity or pension
for commissioned officers retired prior to the effective date of this Decree, and (b) incentive and additional
pays of the commissioned officers of the Bureau of Coast and Geodetic Survey except longevity pay;
Provided, further, That the increase in longevity pay for the year 1976 shall be subject to the availability of
funds and the approval of the Secretary of National Defense.
Rear AdmiralP 3,000.00
Lieutenant Commander 1,400.00
Lieutenant (Senior Grade)1,100.00
Lieutenant (Junior Grade)900.00

The Secretary of National Defense shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be
necessary to implement the intent and purpose of this Decree.

The sum of FOUR HUNDRED TWENTY THOUSAND PESOS (P420,000.00) is hereby
authorized to be appropriated out of any fund in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, in addition
to the current budget to the Bureau of Coast and Geodetic Survey and shall thereafter be incorporated in its
yearly appropriations to carry into effect the provisions of this Decree:

All provisions of existing laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent
with the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect on January 1, 1976.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of November in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
